Project.NAME: YiCamAlt
Project.keywords: yi-camera, android, rtsp, streaming, alternative-client, camera, protocol-reverse-engineering, live-view
Project.annotation: Альтернативный Android-клиент для камер Yi Home / Yi Dome с открытой архитектурой, обходящий ограничения платной подписки. Приложение обеспечивает live-view, просмотр архива событий, управление камерой и работу с облачными/локальными хранилищами.

M-CONFIG.NAME: Config
M-CONFIG.purpose: Central application configuration: feature flags, API base URLs, build variants, and runtime settings.

fn-getApiBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Return base URL for Yi Cloud API (prefers user override, else BuildConfig)

fn-setApiBaseUrl.PURPOSE: Persist a runtime API base URL override

fn-isLocalRtspEnabled.PURPOSE: Check if local RTSP is allowed by config

fn-flag.PURPOSE: Look up a single flag by name; throws MissingKey if absent

M-CONFIG.change-summary: ConfigModule implemented: reads BuildConfig once at construction, exposes typed accessors + feature flags. ConfigError.MissingKey. Runtime API base URL override via SettingsStore (PrefsSettingsStore + InMemorySettingsStore) so the app can point at a real Yi Cloud endpoint; setApiBaseUrl persists the override. Phase-1 gate green (39 tests).

M-HTTP.NAME: HttpClient
M-HTTP.purpose: Shared HTTP client (OkHttp + Retrofit2) with TLS config, auth interceptor, error mapping, and retry policy.

fn-rebuild.PURPOSE: Rebuild Retrofit from current config base URL

M-HTTP.change-summary: HttpClientModule implemented: OkHttp+Retrofit, auth interceptor, redacted logging (redactHeader), single-refresh 401 authenticator. AuthProvider contract introduced. Retrofit made rebuildable via rebuild() so a runtime base URL change takes effect. Phase-1 gate green (39 tests).

M-LOCAL-DB.NAME: LocalDatabase
M-LOCAL-DB.purpose: Room-based local persistence for event cache, config state, and offline playback manifest.
M-LOCAL-DB.change-summary: YiDatabase implemented: CameraEntity/EventEntity/AppMetaEntity + DAOs (abstract-class DAOs emit BLOCK_DB_WRITE). DatabaseModule Hilt provider with onCreate callback (BLOCK_INIT_DB). Test written (Robolectric), deferred (no Android SDK).

M-AUTH.NAME: Authentication
M-AUTH.purpose: Handle Yi Cloud authentication: login, token refresh, session management, secure token storage.

fn-login.PURPOSE: Authenticate with Yi Cloud and store tokens

fn-refreshToken.PURPOSE: Refresh access token using refresh token

fn-getAccessToken.PURPOSE: Return current valid access token (refreshes on expiry)

fn-isLoggedIn.PURPOSE: Check if user has valid session

fn-refresh.PURPOSE: Refresh access token using refresh token; returns null on failure

contract-LoginPort.PURPOSE: Thin login contract consumed by M-UI-LOGIN; implemented by AuthRepository

M-AUTH.change-summary: AuthRepository implemented: login/refresh/logout/getSession, implements AuthProvider + LoginPort. EncryptedAuthStore (EncryptedSharedPreferences). YiCloudAuthApi (Retrofit). Hilt bindings. Login endpoint corrected to real Yi Cloud surface: GET /v4/users/login (query params seq/account/password/dev_name/dev_type/dev_os_version) + POST /v4/users/auth_token for refresh; response code deserialized as String; missing access_token -> InvalidCredentials. Test written (MockWebServer), deferred (no Android SDK).

v0.3.1 audit fix: reverted unfounded 'login' query-param rename back to 'account' — live probes of gw-us/eu/sg.xiaoyi.com/v4/users/login decoded the error ladder (unrecognized account param -> 20250; account without password -> 20260; account+password -> 20253; GET no-params -> 20203; POST no-body -> -10003). Failure log now carries the server message.

v0.4.2 VERIFIED ON DEVICE (2026-09-09): real login works end-to-end — GET /v4/users/login with account + HMAC-SHA256 password -> code 20000 -> token/token_secret/userid -> EncryptedSharedPreferences -> HomeScreen «Вход выполнен», user 167315. Fix chain: account param (not login), HMAC password digest, token_secret as refresh key, DEFAULT_EXPIRES_SECONDS when expires_in absent, authInterceptor bypass for auth_token calls, post-login HomeScreen navigation.

M-CAMERA-LIST.NAME: CameraRegistry
M-CAMERA-LIST.purpose: Fetch and cache the list of user-attached Yi cameras from cloud API. Provides device status, model info, and stream URL resolution.

fn-getCameraList.PURPOSE: Fetch camera list from cloud (/v8/cloud/deviceList) and refresh Room cache

fn-getCameraById.PURPOSE: Get single camera info by deviceId from cache

fn-getLiveStreamUrl.PURPOSE: Resolve live stream URL (cloud or local) for a camera

fn-cacheCameraList.PURPOSE: Persist camera list to local DB

M-CAMERA-LIST.change-summary: M-CAMERA-LIST implemented: CameraRegistry (getCameraList/cache/getById/updateStatus/getLiveStreamUrl), YiCloudDeviceApi GET v8/cloud/deviceList (reverse-engineered path), CameraInfo + shape-tolerant CameraListParser (JsonNull-guarded; provisional field keys). 9 module tests green. Live response shape still unconfirmed — provisional pending capture.

M-CAMERA-CMD.NAME: CameraCommand
M-CAMERA-CMD.purpose: Send camera control commands: PTZ, IR, sound, capture photo, recording mode via cloud relay.

fn-sendPTZCommand.PURPOSE: Send PTZ rotation command (joystick delta to degrees)

M-CAMERA-CMD.change-summary: M-CAMERA-CMD implemented: CameraCommandService with model/online validation + PTZ normalization + CommandTransport seam (provisional POST v8/device/control, code 20000 ack — path unconfirmed). 9 module tests green. Real control endpoint pending live capture.

M-EVENT.NAME: EventService
M-EVENT.purpose: Fetch, cache, and manage motion/event timeline from Yi Cloud. Paginated event list with thumbnails and playback URLs.

fn-getEventById.PURPOSE: Get single event with full details

fn-getPlaybackUrl.PURPOSE: Resolve playback URL for an event

fn-syncEventsToDb.PURPOSE: Cache events to local Room database

M-STREAM-LIVE.NAME: LiveStream
M-STREAM-LIVE.purpose: Establish and manage live video stream from a Yi camera. Lifecycle management, reconnection, quality adaptation.

fn-startStream.PURPOSE: Initialize and connect to camera stream

fn-getLatencyMs.PURPOSE: Return current measured latency in ms

M-STREAM-DECODE.NAME: StreamDecoder
M-STREAM-DECODE.purpose: Handle video stream decryption (AES-128) and decoding. Wraps ExoPlayer MediaSource with decryption support.

fn-createDecryptedSource.PURPOSE: Create ExoPlayer MediaSource from encrypted URL + AES key

fn-handshakeWithCamera.PURPOSE: Perform handshake to obtain AES session key

fn-validateKey.PURPOSE: Verify AES key is valid before creating source

M-EVENT-PLAYBACK.NAME: EventPlayback
M-EVENT-PLAYBACK.purpose: Playback of recorded event clips. Resolves playback URL, manages download buffer, delegates to ExoPlayer.

fn-seekTo.PURPOSE: Seek to position (ms) in the event clip

M-PUSH.NAME: PushService
M-PUSH.purpose: Manage FCM push notifications: device registration, payload handling, local notification display, deep-link navigation.

fn-registerDevice.PURPOSE: Register device token with Yi Cloud and Firebase

fn-showLocalNotification.PURPOSE: Show Android notification for event alert

fn-deepLinkFromPush.PURPOSE: Navigate to event playback from push

M-MEDIA.NAME: MediaService
M-MEDIA.purpose: Manage media files: photos, downloaded clips, thumbnail caching, media store integration.

fn-getLocalThumbnail.PURPOSE: Get cached thumbnail path for event

fn-clearMediaCache.PURPOSE: Clear downloaded media to free space

M-UI-SHELL.NAME: AppShell
M-UI-SHELL.purpose: Top-level post-login home (Phase-1.5 stub): session confirmation, user id, logout. Full bottom-nav shell arrives in Phase-2.
M-UI-SHELL.change-summary: v0.4.2: device logs showed LoginUiState.Success with NO destination (MainActivity mounted LoginScreen unconditionally; onLoggedIn was a no-op). Created HomeScreen stub (BLOCK_RENDER_SHELL) and wired MainActivity navigation Login -> Home -> Settings with BLOCK_HANDLE_LOGOUT; session restore on app start via auth.getSession().

M-UI-LIVEVIEW.NAME: LiveViewScreen
M-UI-LIVEVIEW.purpose: Live view screen: video surface, PTZ joystick, quality selector, camera selector, disconnect.

M-UI-EVENTS.NAME: EventsScreen
M-UI-EVENTS.purpose: Events screen: timeline/grid of motion events with thumbnails, date filter, camera selector.

fn-EventTimelineList.PURPOSE: Vertical list of events grouped by date

M-UI-EVENTPLAYBACK.NAME: EventPlaybackScreen
M-UI-EVENTPLAYBACK.purpose: Event playback screen: video player, seek bar, controls, event metadata overlay.

M-UI-SETTINGS.NAME: SettingsScreen
M-UI-SETTINGS.purpose: Settings screen: account info, camera management, app preferences, about/feedback.

M-UI-LOGIN.NAME: LoginScreen
M-UI-LOGIN.purpose: Login/registration screen: email/password form, loading state, error display.

fn-LoginViewModel.PURPOSE: View-model driving login form state + submit flow

fn-LoginErrorDisplay.PURPOSE: Show error message from auth result

M-UI-LOGIN.change-summary: LoginScreen + LoginViewModel implemented: Compose form, LoginUiState (Idle/Loading/Success/Error), depends on LoginPort. onLoggedIn callback on Success. VM unit test written (JUnit5+coroutines-test); Compose UI test written (androidTest, deferred). No Android SDK to run yet.

M-ONBOARDING.NAME: Onboarding
M-ONBOARDING.purpose: Initial onboarding: welcome, permissions, account setup, camera pairing instructions.

M-CAMERA-DISCOVERY.NAME: CameraDiscovery
M-CAMERA-DISCOVERY.purpose: Discover Yi cameras on local network via mDNS/Bonjour and proprietary protocol.

fn-getDiscoveredCameras.PURPOSE: Return list of discovered local cameras

M-CAMERA-SETUP.NAME: CameraSetup
M-CAMERA-SETUP.purpose: Handle camera Wi-Fi setup: ez-setup (AP mode), WPS, cloud-assisted pairing.
